rationale: Non-goals section (1.2) explicitly lists 5 concrete 'not-to-use' cases with redirects to alternative tools. Each non-goal is verifiable: e.g., '不用于代码文件评审 —— 代码审查请使用 gsd-code-review + gsd-code-fixer'. Use_When section also clearly defines trigger conditions. Meets rubric 'excellent' criterion of '目标/非目标二分明确，且非目标具体可验证'. Slight deduction because one non-goal ('不保证零问题收敛') is more of a limitation than a boundary, but still clearly stated.
